bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/accessory_access.rs (bifrost_app::accessory_access), springboard/core/src/accessory_manager.rs, springboard/core/src/usb_descriptors.rs; related: springboard/src/bare/input.rs (evdev device discovery), springboard/src/bare/docbroker.rs (file grants), springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs (permission manifest)
summary: Accessory Access is a USB-only framework: an app registers listeners that match connected USB accessories through IOUSBHost and receives attach and detach events. BifrOSt has an SDK surface for the accessory manager, the accessory object, matching criteria, events and errors, built on a pure model. Nothing reports real bus attach or detach to it, the sandbox does not bind USB device nodes, and no USB permission grant exists.

features.note: AccessoryManager::sync takes a full bus snapshot, detaches what is missing, attaches what is new and reports the connection ids it changed; apps reach the manager through the SDK module, and both behaviours are tested headless. Gap: no bus source feeds sync with real enumeration yet, which needs hardware and a lab check on Midget.

The device descriptors, configuration and strings are public fields, and a detached accessory keeps its identity record, tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no bus source fills the strings and configuration yet, which needs hardware.

Criteria select by vendor, product, class, subclass and protocol, and by interface; a device with no configuration read does not match an interface criterion, tested in core/tests and sdk/tests parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: the criteria can only be checked against descriptors the caller has read, which needs hardware.

Events are queued per listener key, a detach reaches only the listeners told of the attach, and sync produces them from a snapshot; all tested headless in core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Gap: no hotplug source on a real bus feeds them yet, which needs hardware.

features.feature: Kernel USB enumeration and system visibility
features.apple: IOUSBHost (underlies the framework, per the landing page)
features.bifrost: springboard/sdk/src/accessory_access.rs (AccessoryManager, MatchingCriteria, attach and detach events); springboard/ui/src/device_browser.rs (USB device snapshots, add and remove events); springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs:245 (binds /sys and /run/udev read-only into the app sandbox); springboard/src/installer/plan.rs:186 (raises the USB interrupt thread priority)
features.note: Apps match accessories by criteria and receive attach and detach events, and the device browser reports which USB devices came and went, both tested inline in their pure models. Gap: the sandbox binds no USB device nodes, so no app reaches a real accessory, and the shell supplies the bus snapshots.

features.feature: Permission and access grant for USB devices
features.apple: Accessory Access authorization (accessory matching and listener registration)
features.note: Exclusive open by one owner, close only by that owner, and refusal of a disconnected accessory are modelled and tested headless. Gap: the permission manifest has no USB device permission and no prompt, so an app cannot request a grant yet, which needs the sandbox and hardware.

Error values have readable messages and are exposed to apps; the open and state messages are checked in sdk/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs and core/tests/parity_sdk-complete-14.rs. Not yet verified on Midget.

gaps: No bus source calls attach and detach for USB accessories, so no app receives real hotplug events yet.
No USB device permission in the app permission manifest (springboard/src/bare/app_policy.rs), and no grant flow comparable to docbroker.rs for USB.
The accessory object's descriptors come from the caller; nothing reads them from a device.
No USB device nodes are bound into the app sandbox, so a listener cannot match a real accessory from an app.
